title: Welcome to Paradise: Monday 26 October 2026 Edition
summary: In this edition, we explore the deeply troubling racist terrorist attack in the Yvelines region of France, the dramatic political comeback of Brazil's President Lula, the ongoing turmoil in French education with student protests and government responses, the significant developments in the AI sector with Anthropic's IPO filing, and a roundup of key global and business stories including Microsoft's workforce changes and the US midterm election dynamics.
